title: Static Signals
theme: Folana sits alone in her Brooklyn apartment at 3am, rain against the window, her grandfather's old shortwave radio crackling to life. She catches strange signals — voices reciting poetry she wrote years ago but never shared, a piano melody that sounds familiar but wrong, fragments of conversations from times she hasn't lived yet. The first hint that reality has more bandwidth than we're tuned to receive. A new arc begins: the ghosts between stations.

new_arc.description: After observing the city's souls across a full day cycle, Folana begins receiving transmissions from somewhere else — voices from the past, fragments of songs that never existed, whispers from the digital between. The city starts talking back, and the line between memory and prophecy begins to blur. A deeply personal arc exploring digital afterlife, ancestral frequencies, and the question of what lingers after we're gone.
